```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

plant_lep_df_raw <- read_excel(
  "posts/host-plant-lepidoptra-network/data/zookeys_-1261-101-s001.xlsx",
  skip = 1
) |>
  clean_names()


plant_lep_df_raw
```


```{r}
glimpse(plant_lep_df_raw)
```

```{r}
#top leps in terms of host plants
top_lep_hosts <- plant_lep_df_raw |>
  select(lep_common_name, count_host_plant_genera) |>
  mutate(count_host_plant_genera = parse_number(count_host_plant_genera))

top_lep_hosts |>
  ggplot(aes(count_host_plant_genera)) +
  geom_histogram()

top_lep_hosts |>
  filter(count_host_plant_genera == max(count_host_plant_genera, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
common_name_target <- tibble(
  lep_common_name = c(
    "Monarch",
    "Spicebush Swallowtail",
    "Eastern Tiger Swallowtail",
    "Virginian Tiger Moth, Yellow Woolybear Moth, Yellow Bear",
    "Fall Armyworm Moth"
  )
)

plant_lep_df <- plant_lep_df_raw |>
  mutate(
    host_genera = str_squish(host_genera),
    ud_lep_number = as.character(ud_lep_number)
  ) |>
  #semi_join(common_name_target, by = "lep_common_name") |>
  #select(lep_common_name, host_genera) |>
  separate_rows(host_genera, sep = " ") |>
  select(
    host_genera,
    ud_lep_number,
    lep_common_name,
    species_complete_binomial_nomenclature
  ) |>
  drop_na(host_genera, ud_lep_number)

view(plant_lep_df)
```

 
```{r}
network <- plant_lep_df |>
  select(host_genera, ud_lep_number) |>
  as_tbl_graph(directed = TRUE)

network

common_name_lookup <- plant_lep_df |>
  distinct(
    ud_lep_number,
    species_complete_binomial_nomenclature,
    lep_common_name
  ) |>
  semi_join(common_name_target)

common_name_lookup |>
  semi_join(common_name_target)
```


```{r}
plot(network)
```

```{r}
network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  view()
```
```{r}
network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  left_join(
    common_name_lookup,
    by = c("name" = "ud_lep_number")
  ) |>
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +
  geom_node_point()

network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  left_join(
    common_name_lookup,
    by = c("name" = "ud_lep_number")
  ) |>
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +
  #geom_edge_bend() +
  geom_node_point() +
  geom_node_label(aes(
    filter = name %in% common_name_lookup$ud_lep_number,
    label = str_wrap(lep_common_name, 14)
  ))
```
